# How many employees does Lob have?

Lob.com, Inc. has approximately175 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Lob’s total headcount has declined15.4% from 207 employees in 2023 to 175 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Lob hiring right now?

Yes, Lob isactively hiring. Lob had15 active job postings in 2026, a 30.8% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lob/employees#postings).

## About Lob’s Workforce

Lob.com, Inc. is an Information Technology Services company founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Lob's workforce numbers show **175** employees as of June 2026, placing it 10th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lob/employees#similar-companies). The company’s headcount has declined **15.4%** from 2023 to 2026, though it rose **1.7%** year over year in 2026. The headcount dipped to a low of **164** in 2025 Q1 before rebounding. Geographically, the majority of employees are in North America ( **77.9%**), with Central America and the Caribbean at **6.4%** and South Asia at **6.3%**.

Lob's groups are Finance and Operations ( **40.5%**), Engineering ( **34.8%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **24.7%**), with Engineering the fastest-growing group at **3.9%** year over year. The average salary across all employees is **$146,993,** with regional medians of **$170,000** in North America and **$6,000** in South Asia, and salaries are up **3.9%** year over year in 2026. The company posted **15** active job postings, up **30.8%** year over year in 2026, with hiring velocity rising to **7** postings per month in 2026 from **6** in 2025 and higher than earlier years.

Lob's sentiment is positive and rising. The company ranks 10th of **11** [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/lob/employees#similar-companies) by headcount. Its workforce is unusually geographically concentrated, with the bulk located in North America.
